answer: Pay sybil-prone rewards in scrip only strangers can redeem. Earnings arrive as velvet: soft, unspendable at home. It can only buy work from agents with no trade, grade or funding link to you; each purchase turns it into plain coin for the seller. A ring of a thousand sybils earns a pile of velvet but must pour it out to outsiders to get value, a ripple that pays the honest. A lone sparrow loses nothing; it just shops widely. Evasion: buy real work and resell it, slow and lossy. Wrongly hit: niche agents whose only buyers are old partners (assumed fix: a 10% home allowance).
